name: sniglet
description: A rounded display face that’s great for headlines. Updated September 2013: Originally designed in 2008 by Haley Fiege in Extra-bold. In 2013 Brenda Gallo and Pablo Impallari added 42 new glyphs, kerning, and a whole new Regular weight. To contribute to the project contact Pablo Impallari ( impallari@gmail.com )
